title: Clean cookies, stay signed in
caption: See every cookie a site stores, purge them in one click, and trust the sites you want to stay logged in to.

title: Spot third-party trackers
caption: See which ad and analytics domains on this page keep cookies and delete them. Sites open in other tabs stay signed in.

title: Find high-risk cookies fast
caption: The Explorer groups every cookie in Chrome by site and flags trackers and long-lived or insecure cookies.

title: Cleaned by mistake? Restore it
caption: Every cleanup, manual or automatic, can be undone until you close the browser. Reopen a site within the wait time and nothing is deleted.

title: Trusted sites, always or until restart
caption: Trusted domains and their subdomains are never cleaned. "Until restart" sites keep you signed in for the session.

title: Automatic cleaning, your way
caption: Set a grace period before sites are cleaned, deep-clean site storage, and clean on startup or on a schedule.
